content.short: Arkham Intelligence is an AI-powered blockchain analytics platform that deanonymizes on-chain activity and tracks real-world entities behind wallet addresses.
content.description: Arkham Intelligence provides institutional-grade blockchain analytics powered by artificial intelligence, with its core product being the Arkham Intel Exchange  a marketplace for buying and selling on-chain intelligence about wallets, entities, and transactions. The platform's AI engine identifies real-world entities behind blockchain addresses, enabling traders, researchers, and compliance teams to track fund flows and analyze wallet behavior at scale. Arkham covers major networks including Mantle and has become a go-to tool for on-chain due diligence and investigation across the crypto industry.
content.meta: Arkham Intelligence uses AI to analyze and deanonymize blockchain activity across networks including Mantle. Discover Arkham on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
